verdict.rationale: Vercel ships preview/branch deployments and per-environment variable management (local/preview/production) explicitly separate from production, plus a dedicated Sandbox for running untrusted/agent-generated code in ephemeral isolated microVMs — directly enabling AI-native testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of database-level data isolation for preview environments (only third-party Neon branching is mentioned) and independent hands-on confirmation that preview environments never leak into production data stores.
